dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (II)
dialogues.text: Great view from the bell tower, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (II)
dialogues.text: Head to the top and follow the <color=#00E2FFFF>sound of the bell</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Message From a City Resident (II)
dialogues.text: It will lead you to my treasure.
